title: Degree-two characteristic-p vanishing for arbitrary constant coefficients
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of prime characteristic p, Λ any commutative ring, and f : C → Spec k a smooth separated connected scheme of finite type and dimension at most one [def-sc-curves]. The degree-two Ext cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] of the underlying abelian sheaf of the constant Λ-module sheaf Λ/pΛ [def-sc-constant-sheaves] is zero. No finiteness or characteristic hypothesis on Λ is imposed.

proof.text: Compare Ext cohomology in degree two with derived etale cohomology. Split on topologicalKrullDim C = 1. In that case form IsConnectedCurve f from the existing hypotheses and apply Artin-Schreier vanishing with q = 2. Otherwise the dimension bound gives topologicalKrullDim C ≤ 0 by Order.le_of_lt_succ. Use the existing algebraic-closure point at each x and apply zero_dimensional_etale_cohomology_rest to C.constantZMod p. Transport both cases through the Ext/derived comparison to obtain IsZero of H²(C,constantZMod p).

Apply lem-sc-constant-mod-charp-finite-sum-colimit to present the underlying Λ/pΛ sheaf as a coefficient-universe filtered colimit of finite biproducts of constantZMod p. Sheaf.functorH is additive and preserves finite biproducts. Map each finite-stage isomorphism and compose with mapBiproduct. Every projection of the identity on the resulting cohomology biproduct is zero, since its target is H²(C,constantZMod p). biproduct.hom_ext and IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero prove every value of the mapped diagram zero.

C is compact by QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f and quasi-separated by quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f. Apply sheafH_isColimit_large_filtered in degree two. The mapped diagram is zero, so IsColimit.isZero_pt makes its colimit point zero. AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero gives precisely the unchanged conclusion.
